title: Goofy Ahh SpongeBob
blurb: Goofy ahh SpongeBob — Bikini Bottom processed through the goofy ahh filter, where even a cartoon sponge gets more cartoonish. It's two comedy universes colliding: SpongeBob's chaos energy warped into brainrot's house style. Play it when regular SpongeBob sounds are somehow too dignified for the moment. Yes, that situation exists.
